usable_for: 36人比较研究中，ChatGPT条件下跨用户想法的语义差异更小，可有限支持创意趋同风险假设。

sources.title: open-city-ai/haidian公开方案机制目录

sources.publisher: open-city-ai contributors
usable_for: 扫描当前仓库全部投稿的标题、摘要和机制线索，并对最接近的方向阅读全文，以识别同义表述与相近空间后果，只用于原创性核查。
usable_for_en: Scan the titles, summaries and mechanism signals of all submissions in the current repository, then review the full text of the nearest neighbours to identify synonymous expressions and adjacent spatial consequences, solely for originality review.
not_usable_for: 不把出现次数写成支持率，不复制标题、正文、图式、图像或独特组合，也不外推为之后的绝对最新。
not_usable_for_en: Does not convert frequency into a support rate, copy titles, text, diagrams, images or distinctive combinations, or claim to cover later changes.
